note.en: Poisson identifies the self-consistent electrostatic field; the registry does not list the complete coupled particle-motion/CIC PIC system. Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.

Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.
